messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Sorry for the oversight  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I wanted to apologize for [briefly describe what happened, e.g., missing the deadline on the report]. I understand it caused inconvenience, and I take full responsibility. I’ve already [corrective action, e.g., submitted the revised document] and will ensure it doesn’t happen again. Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make things right.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]

PLAN:
- No external tool needed; draft email directly.
- Review tone and brevity before sending.
